summary: Round r1 (restricted network; web-search budget exhausted, SAARC/BIMSTEC and depositary hosts blocked). Thirteen leads recorded: SAARC and BIMSTEC secretariats (landing pages), SASEC for BBIN, the NTIP agreement register, TEPC texts of the India trade and transit treaties, MoFA Nepal, WTO RTA database and tariff data, UN Comtrade, ITC Trade Map, the World Bank Nepal CEM 2025 and a method reference. Q1 (ratified/operational vs signed/proposed): a fifteen-row agreement status table is set up across SAARC, BIMSTEC, BBIN and conditioning bilateral treaties; each row requires signature date, entry into force, Nepal's party status and implementation evidence from the secretariat/depositary record, and all are pending - no status is asserted from memory. Q2 (measurable SAFTA effects): four evidence types and key attribution problems are defined; no SAFTA utilisation or econometric study was located, so all effects are pending. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Q1: Ratification and operational status of SAARC, BIMSTEC and BBIN instruments (fifteen rows in specific.agreement_status_table) is pending.
findings.note: Secretariat/depositary ratification records; WTO RTA notifications; implementing records (e.g. customs preference claims, vehicle permits, grid transactions).

findings.claim: Q2: SAFTA preference utilisation for Nepal's exports and imports.
findings.note: Customs data on imports cleared under SAFTA preference, Nepal FY; partner customs data for Nepal's exports claiming SAFTA.

findings.claim: Q2: Documented econometric trade effects of SAFTA (regional and Nepal-specific).
findings.note: No study located in r1; locate peer-reviewed gravity-model studies and World Bank/ADB regional integration reports in r2.

findings.claim: Q2: Preference margins on Nepal's principal export lines under SAFTA vs MFN.
findings.note: Tariff line data by partner, latest year.

findings.claim: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.

A regional arrangement is treated as contributing to baseline trade, transit or electricity only when OPERATIONAL; announced or signed-not-in-force instruments are scenario options with named preconditions.

assumptions.text: Status classes used throughout Agent 17 r1: OPERATIONAL (in force and evidenced in use by an implementing record), IN_FORCE_NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_USE, SIGNED_NOT_IN_FORCE (awaiting ratification or implementing instruments), AGREED_IN_PRINCIPLE_OR_ANNOUNCED (joint statement, minutes or press release only), PROPOSED (study, DPR or negotiation), LAPSED_OR_STALLED. A status is assigned only from a retrieved primary document (treaty text, gazette/notification, ratification record, implementing-agency record); news items only locate documents.
Instruments are listed from domain knowledge only to structure the search; every row stays pending until a secretariat/depositary or national ratification record is retrieved.
Trade effects attributed to SAFTA must control for bilateral India-Nepal preferences and transport costs.

challenges.text: Please supply LDC-graduation implications for SAFTA special-and-differential provisions (LDC treatment within SAFTA) so the status table can flag provisions that lapse on graduation.

X30 lists SAARC, BIMSTEC, BBIN and bilateral treaties together; bilateral India/China treaties are held by 17A/17B. Suggest 17D owns only multilateral/plurilateral rows and cross-references bilateral rows to avoid duplicate status records.
Catalog lacks a depositary/treaty-status source (e.g. national gazette of treaty ratifications, Nepal Treaty Act records) - required to establish Nepal's party status independently of secretariats.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no primary text or ratification record was retrieved. The instrument list is provisional and may be incomplete (new instruments from recent BIMSTEC summits could be missing). The SAFTA effect literature was not searched successfully; its existence and direction for Nepal are unknown at this stage.

agreement_status_table.method: One row per instrument; status class per 17D-A1 assigned only from secretariat/depositary/national ratification records plus an implementing record for OPERATIONAL.

documented_effects.question: Q2 What measurable trade effects of SAFTA are documented?

evidence_types_sought.type: Preference utilisation rates (share of eligible imports entering under SAFTA preferences)
evidence_types_sought.sources: customs administrations' preference-claim data; secretariat reports

evidence_types_sought.type: Preference margins (MFN minus SAFTA rate) on Nepal's export lines
evidence_types_sought.sources: WTO TTD, ITC Market Access Map

evidence_types_sought.type: Ex-post econometric estimates of SAFTA effects on intra-regional trade (gravity models)
evidence_types_sought.status: pending - no study located in r1

evidence_types_sought.type: Descriptive intra-SAARC trade shares before/after SAFTA

attribution_issues: Nepal's trade is dominated by India, where the bilateral Treaty of Trade already grants preferences; SAFTA's incremental effect for Nepal is likely hard to separate from bilateral preferences (method issue, not a finding)
Sensitive lists and non-tariff measures limit coverage
Calendar-year international data vs Nepal FY customs data
documented_effects.method: Report each documented effect with study, period, method and identification strategy; keep conflicting estimates side by side; do not generalise regional estimates to Nepal without Nepal-specific evidence.
